label: Review invites
description: Email customers a link to your Senja form after their order is delivered. Requires the Senja connection above.

fields.label: Senja form ID
fields.description: The form customers are invited to fill in. In Senja, open the form and copy the ID from its URL.

fields.label: Days after delivery
fields.description: How long to wait after an order is fully delivered before sending the invite.

fields.label: Only invite customers who accept marketing emails
fields.description: Some regions (such as the EU) treat review requests as marketing. Turn this on to invite only customers who opted in to marketing emails.
